name: Dollar stack: MNEE
description: Moves a little BSV into MNEE (a dollar stablecoin) at a time, and only when MNEE is listed at or under $1.01, so it never pays much over the peg. At most $5 a buy, $10 a day, $100 in total. It can lose money: market fees, the BSV price at the moment of buying, and the stablecoin itself all carry risk.
goals: Hold part of this account's value in MNEE. Buy MNEE in $5 steps, only at $1.01 or less per token. Stop at $100.

spec.needs: Agent account with at least $20 of BSV; MNEE listings on the market
